name: valid-bearer-token-opens-stream
description: A valid bearer token should return 200 with correct SSE headers and the initial handshake (retry + stream.opened).

name: missing-auth-rejects-with-401
description: No Authorization header and no session cookie must produce a JSON EnvelopeError code=unauthorized and never write SSE frame bytes.

name: non-whitelisted-origin-rejects-403
description: SSE connections from Origins outside the CORS allowlist must short-circuit 403 cors.origin_not_allowed.

name: fourth-concurrent-stream-429-too-many-connections
description: Default SSE_MAX_CONCURRENT_PER_USER=3; opening a 4th connection for the same identity should return 429 with Retry-After and code sse.stream.too_many_connections.

name: reconnect-with-last-event-id-replays-gap
description: Reconnecting with Last-Event-ID=N should replay events strictly greater than N with replay_applied=true and correct replay_count.

name: single-notification-fans-out-to-N-connections
description: Publish 1 blog.comment.created domain event; every one of N=5 connected SSE clients for the same user receives the notification.created frame within 500ms with identical notification_id.

name: cross-user-isolation-no-leak
description: Publishing to user A must never deliver frames to user B's connection, even when both are open on the same server process.

name: slow-consumer-buffer-overflow-emits-error-frame
description: Attach a 1 frame/sec consumer; flood 1000 events. Expect exactly 1 event: error with code=fanout.buffer_full and integer dropped_count, other clients unaffected.

name: aggressive-reconnect-jail
description: 12 connects inside a 60s window for the same ip:user tuple → last several return 429 sse.stream.jailed with Retry-After=120.

name: session-invalidated-family-closes-stream
description: Publish user.session.invalidated_family domain event; every open stream for that user receives event: session.invalidated_family then server closes stream within 250ms; client wrapper dispatches auth:logout-required.
